mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meeting_sync_outbox (id, enterprise_id, revision, created_at, updated_at, binding_id, business_key, command_id, desired_version, delivered_version, record_id, create_token, claim_token, lease_until, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, payload_json, last_error_code, last_request_id, run_id, status) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.enterpriseId}, 1, #{now}, #{now}, #{row.bindingId}, #{row.businessKey}, #{row.commandId}, 1, 0, NULL, #{row.createToken}, NULL, NULL, 0, #{row.maxAttempts}, #{now}, #{row.payloadJson}, NULL, NULL, #{row.runId}, 'pending') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE command_id = VALUES(command_id), desired_version = desired_version + 1, attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = VALUES(next_attempt_at), payload_json = VALUES(payload_json), run_id = VALUES(run_id), status = 'pending', revision = revision + 1, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE meeting_sync_outbox SET claim_token = #{token}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE binding_id = #{bindingId} AND business_key = #{businessKey} AND status = 'pending' AND delivered_version < desired_version AND attempt_count < max_attempts AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (claim_token IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now})
UPDATE meeting_sync_outbox SET record_id = #{recordId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE binding_id = #{bindingId} AND business_key = #{businessKey} AND claim_token = #{token}

UPDATE meeting_sync_outbox SET status = 'failed', claim_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'pending' AND attempt_count >= max_attempts AND (claim_token IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now})
